goals.name: attack_20
goals.note: Nothing tells the run it is finished. This condition is re-read every cycle, and the run ends the cycle it holds.

rules.name: retreat_after_a_beating
rules.note: The stop reason from the last fight is a fact, so this reads it. A plan that is a list can only retry the fight that caused it.

rules.name: train_on_something_that_cannot_hurt_back
rules.note: HP comes back over real time, not over retries. Fifteen minutes on chickens is how that time gets spent; the cooldown is the condition above, not a special case in the runner.

rules.name: walk_to_the_goblins
rules.note: known() asks routes.json, so a landmark nobody has confirmed yet cannot send a character walking at a guess.

rules.name: fight_the_goblins
rules.note: An empty condition always matches. Last in the file, it is the catch-all; anywhere else it would shadow everything under it.
